Shot of the Week

A fresh JNC shot every week—complete with the recipe, the vibe, the episode, and just enough chaos to make it memorable.

Featured Recipe

Oyster Shooter

The vibe: Briny, bold, and spicy—a freshly shucked oyster meets chilled vodka, tomato juice, hot sauce, and lemon in one unforgettable shot.

Ingredients
  • Freshly shucked oyster1
  • Vodka1 oz
  • Tomato juice or Bloody Mary mix½ oz
  • Hot sauceDash
  • Fresh lemonSmall squeeze
Method

Place the oyster in a shot glass, add the remaining ingredients, and serve immediately.

Watch the Episode Browse Recipes
Base SpiritVodka
FlavorBriny & Spicy
Prep Time2 Minutes
ServeShot Glass
More Than a Recipe

Behind the Drink

Connect each weekly shot to the show where it appeared, so visitors can watch the segment instead of landing on a dead-end recipe graphic.

See It Mixed on JNC Open the featured episode on YouTube
“A bold little taste of the coast in one spicy shot.”

The Oyster Shooter brings together a freshly shucked oyster, vodka, tomato juice or Bloody Mary mix, hot sauce, and a squeeze of lemon for a briny, savory kick.

This one is quick, fresh, and built for the kind of fearless on-air tasting that makes Shot of the Week feel like a little experiment behind the bar.
